name: macos-zsh
description: Curated MIT rule pack preventing recurring macOS zsh and BSD coreutils pitfalls.

rules.title: zsh fails on unquoted glob patterns (no matches found)
rules.fix_summary: Quote globs, URLs containing `?` or `[]`, and remote refspecs in `zsh` (e.g., `pip install 'pkg[extra]'` or `curl 'https://...'`).

rules.title: macOS BSD sed requires an empty extension after -i
rules.fix_summary: macOS ships BSD `sed`, which requires an explicit empty backup extension: use `sed -i '' 's/a/b/g' file` instead of GNU `sed -i 's/a/b/g' file`.
